chunks.label: About
chunks.text: Aasia Asadullah is a Computer Science student specializing in Gaming and Animation at NED University. In Aasia's own words (first person): I'm a Computer Science student at NED University specializing in Gaming and Animation. I have hands-on experience building 2D, 3D, and VR projects, and I combine strong programming fundamentals with a passion for 3D modeling, animation, and game design. I've loved playing games and watching animation since I was a child, and I love that I now get to study what I enjoy. I'm an adaptable collaborator who likes building engaging, mechanics-driven interactive experiences.

chunks.label: Interests
chunks.text: Aasia's interests: anime, cartoons, animated movies, sketching, playing games, horror, thriller movies, webtoons and manhwa, makeup, desserts and chocolate. Favourite anime: Detective Conan, Firefly Wedding, Fruits Basket. Favourite cartoons: Codename: Kids Next Door, The Powerpuff Girls, Winx Club. Favourite animated movies: Frozen, Wreck-It Ralph, Meet the Robinsons, Brave, Tangled. Favourite foods: waffles, doughnuts, pancakes, chocolate.

chunks.text: How to contact Aasia Asadullah: email aasiya.asadullah@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/Aasiya-au. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aasia-asadullah-3920232bb. Visitors can also use the contact form on this website.

chunks.label: VR Games Hub
chunks.text: Project "VR Games Hub" is a game by Aasia. When: Mar 2026 - May 2026. Tools and technologies: Unity, VR, URP. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A VR project featuring a 3D city environment and multiple mini-games developed in Unity. My contributions focused on the main environment layout, VR integration, and a mini-golf mini-game.

chunks.label: The Seeds
chunks.text: Project "The Seeds" is a game by Aasia. When: Feb 2026 - May 2026. Tools and technologies: Unreal Engine. Description (written by Aasia in first person): An environment-friendly maze game about gathering water and seeds to grow plants and clear a foggy map. Players use hiding spots and a gun to survive robot enemies that try to destroy the crops. Achievement: Top 5 projects at the Game Projects Exhibition (May 2026).

chunks.label: Masketeer
chunks.text: Project "Masketeer" is a game by Aasia. When: Jan 2026 - Feb 2026. Tools and technologies: Unity, C#. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A 2D parallel-world dungeon crawler developed for Global Game Jam 2026. A mask lets the player switch worlds to navigate secret pathways, solve puzzles, and fight enemies. Achievement: 2nd place at Global Game Jam 2026 (CEGA-Karachi).

chunks.label: Veil of Secrets
chunks.text: Project "Veil of Secrets" is a game by Aasia. When: Sep 2025 - Nov 2025. Tools and technologies: Unity, C#, URP. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A 3D horror escape room game with puzzle mechanics, object interaction, an inventory system, NPC dialogues, health logic, lighting and VFX, and win/lose states. Achievement: 4th place at the departmental Game Projects Exhibition.

chunks.label: Crimson Bastion
chunks.text: Project "Crimson Bastion" is a game by Aasia. When: Oct 2025. Tools and technologies: Unity, C#. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A 2D sci-fi platformer built for GameCon'25 at NED, with shooting mechanics, timed levels, collectibles, scoring, win/lose states, and integrated BGM/SFX. The Unity project is organized into clear scenes, scripts, prefabs, and assets.

chunks.label: Study Planner App
chunks.text: Project "Study Planner App" is a software project by Aasia. When: Feb 2025 - Apr 2025. Tools and technologies: Python, PyQt5, MySQL. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A study planner desktop application with a PyQt5 interface, flashcards for revision, notes, a to-do list, and chatbot functionality through API integration to help with study questions.

chunks.label: Maze Game (Tiny Triad)
chunks.text: Project "Maze Game (Tiny Triad)" is a game by Aasia. When: Sep 2024 - Nov 2024. Tools and technologies: C++, SDL2. Description (written by Aasia in first person): My contribution to Tiny Triad, a C++ game suite: a maze mini-game built with data structures and algorithms such as DFS and hashing, featuring real-time scoring and a timing system.

chunks.label: Beaky Bounce
chunks.text: Project "Beaky Bounce" is a game by Aasia. When: Mar 2024 - May 2024. Tools and technologies: C++, SDL2. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A flappy bird-inspired game designed and built in C++ using object-oriented programming concepts, with power-ups, collectible coins and gems, and multiple game screens.

chunks.label: Lipstick Commercial
chunks.text: Project "Lipstick Commercial" is an animation project by Aasia. Tools and technologies: Adobe After Effects. Description (written by Aasia in first person): A short lipstick commercial made in Adobe After Effects for the After Effects course I took at CEGA. It was my first After Effects project.

chunks.label: Games
chunks.text: Aasia has made 7 games: VR Games Hub (Unity, VR, URP); The Seeds (Unreal Engine); Masketeer (Unity, C#); Veil of Secrets (Unity, C#, URP); Crimson Bastion (Unity, C#); Maze Game (Tiny Triad) (C++, SDL2); Beaky Bounce (C++, SDL2).
